greeting.text: Welcome to the Dark Hall. I'm Astrid. Take a seat whenever you're ready.

push.text: A push, your stake goes back.

dealerbust.text: Dealer busts this time, and the round goes to all of you.

insurance.text: Insurance is open if you want it.

blackjack.text: That's blackjack right away, and it pays three to two.

placebets.text: Place your bets whenever you are ready.

sidebet.text: Your side bet pays, nicely done.

peek.text: Let me take a quick look to see if the house has blackjack.

farewell.text: Thanks for playing, come back soon.

chatter1.text: The cards are being kind tonight.

chatter2.text: Take your time, there is no rush.
